verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence for this story is a single marketing line saying Alloy streamlines perpetual KYC/KYB checks, which implies business-entity screening. Nothing describes inspecting linked ownership, beneficial owners, or association risk. The entity ID and merging docs cover record management, not ownership links. Missing for 10: documented KYB screening workflow, beneficial-ownership/UBO or associated-party linkage, risk context views for linked entities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
